package firstfit

import (
	"context"
	"slices"

	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu"
)

// FlowVisits distinguishes boundary validation from breakpoint search. A resumed
// call checks prefix boundary indexes but searches only the suffix.
type FlowVisits struct{ BoundaryChecks, Search, PrefixSearch int }
type flowControl struct {
	ctx    context.Context
	prefix []int
	resume bool
	visits FlowVisits
}

// FlowBreak is an overlay-only first-fit entry. The reference scans the locked
// prefix; the candidate seeds the same boundaries and starts after its last knot.
// Both reuse the production loop for the suffix, with fresh trim/carry state.
func FlowBreak(ctx context.Context, k *khipu.Khipu, geometry khipu.Params, prefix []int, resume bool) ([]int, FlowVisits, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		return nil, FlowVisits{}, khipu.ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, FlowVisits{}, err
	}
	if !k.FlowNoHyphenation() {
		return nil, FlowVisits{}, khipu.ErrUnsupportedPolicy
	}
	c := &flowControl{ctx: ctx, prefix: slices.Clone(prefix), resume: resume}
	prev := -1
	for _, at := range c.prefix {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return nil, FlowVisits{}, err
		}
		c.visits.BoundaryChecks++
		if at <= prev || at >= len(k.Kind) || k.Penalty[at] >= InfinityDemerits {
			return nil, FlowVisits{}, khipu.ErrIllegalArguments
		}
		prev = at
	}
	breaks, err := flowBreakParagraph(k, geometry, NewDefaultParameters(), c)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, FlowVisits{}, err
	}
	return breaks, c.visits, nil
}
